remarks: Welcome to Riverbend, a highly sought-after community in the Silvermine section of Norwalk. This updated 1-bedroom townhouse with loft offers a bright, open layout designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The recently renovated kitchen, completed just three years ago, features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, soft-close cabinetry, and a classic subway tile backsplash. The oversized living room is filled with natural light and showcases cathedral ceilings, a fireplace, hardwood floors, and sliders leading to a Juliet balcony. The main level primary bedroom suite offers vaulted ceilings, double closets, newer wall-to-wall carpeting, and a full bath. A powder room and in-unit washer and dryer complete the main level. A spiral staircase leads to a versatile loft space with two skylights, ideal for a home office, guest area, or additional living space. Additional features include a private one-car attached garage, lower-level storage, newer central air system with integrated heating, and updated fire alarms. The entire unit has been recently painted, creating a clean, move-in ready feel. Conveniently located with easy access to I-95, Route 7, and the Merritt Parkway. Enjoy being within walking distance to local restaurants, shops, and nightlife, and just minutes to South Norwalk, SoNo Collection, area beaches, and Metro-North.
